verdict.rationale: Gusto's first-party docs say the platform calculates and files taxes automatically, handles multi-state requirements, and covers 'all associated federal, state, and local filings and payments', with Gusto doing the heavy lifting 'from tax calculations to bank transfers'. One community report describes erroneous W-2c filings that double-reported a quarter to the IRS. That is a single accuracy incident, not evidence that automated filing and remittance doesn't exist, so it lowers confidence and quality rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on tax filing and remittance mechanics (agencies, deposit schedules, local-tax coverage specifics) and independent corroboration that automated filing works reliably.
